lede.headline: California's billionaire wealth tax trails after Election Day
lede.dek: Proposition 40's one-time 5% tax on billionaires was down more than 10 points as ballots were still being counted, while a rival measure that would block such taxes was ahead.

top10AsOf: List as of Sep 24, 2026 9:15 PM ET

stories.read: Bearish for the tax, bullish for Brin
stories.headline: Billionaire tax trails as Brin-backed rival leads
stories.move: California's Proposition 40, a one-time 5% tax on net worth above $1 billion for state residents as of Jan. 1, 2026, was trailing 55.27% to 44.73% with 61% of votes counted as of a Nov. 4 update, CalMatters reported. A rival measure, Proposition 42, which would bar the state from taxing financial assets or private businesses, was ahead with about 54% support. Under California's rules, when competing measures are on the same ballot, the one with the most votes wins and nullifies the others, so a win for Prop. 42 would void Prop. 40 even if Prop. 40 also passed. Sergey Brin led the opposition, donating $102 million to the committee Building a Better California, which he founded, and relocated his residency out of state.
stories.why: If the trend holds, California's roughly 200 billionaires avoid a wealth-tax bill that supporters said could raise tens of billions of dollars for healthcare and education.
stories.bear: Only 61% of ballots were counted as of the last update, and the union behind Prop. 40 has said it may put the measure back on the ballot in 2028.
stories.watch: California's certified final vote count, expected in the coming weeks.

stories.read: Buffett adds to a favorite bet
stories.headline: Berkshire keeps buying SiriusXM stock
stories.move: Berkshire Hathaway bought 924,281 more shares of Sirius XM Holdings (SIRI) over three trading days — 743,965 on Oct. 30, 66,968 on Nov. 2 and 113,348 on Nov. 3 — at weighted-average prices from $28.89 to $30.23, an SEC Form 4 shows. The purchases bring Berkshire's stake to 125,731,398 shares, held through GEICO and Berkshire subsidiaries' pension plans.
stories.why: Berkshire has been one of SiriusXM's largest and steadiest buyers since the Liberty Media tracking-stock split, and each purchase adds to an already large position.
stories.bear: SiriusXM has lost subscribers in recent years, so a bigger stake also means bigger exposure if that trend continues.
stories.watch: Berkshire's next Form 4 filings and its Q3 2026 earnings, expected this month.
stories.source: SEC Form 4 (Berkshire Hathaway / Warren E. Buffett)

stories.headline: Berkshire trims its DaVita stake again
stories.move: Berkshire Hathaway sold 382,563 shares of DaVita (DVA) on Oct. 27 at a weighted-average price of $180.43, an SEC Form 4 shows, leaving it with 28,314,666 shares held through GEICO and Berkshire subsidiaries' pension plans.
stories.why: Berkshire's long-standing agreement with DaVita caps its ownership percentage; when DaVita's own buybacks push Berkshire's stake above that ceiling, Berkshire has to sell shares back down.
stories.bear: The sales are mechanical rather than a signal Berkshire has soured on the stock.
stories.watch: Whether Berkshire's next Form 4 shows another trim as DaVita keeps buying back shares.
stories.source: SEC Form 4 (Berkshire Hathaway / Warren E. Buffett)

stories.headline: Carlos Slim keeps selling Talos Energy stock
stories.move: Control Empresarial de Capitales, Carlos Slim's family holding company, sold 1,508,586 shares of Talos Energy (TALO) on Oct. 27 and Oct. 28 at weighted-average prices of $18.50 and $18.33, an SEC Form 4 shows, leaving it with 20,491,414 shares.
stories.why: Slim's investment vehicle has trimmed its Talos stake several times in 2026 as oil-linked stocks have rallied this year.
stories.bear: Slim remains one of Talos's largest shareholders even after the sales, so this looks like profit-taking rather than an exit.
stories.watch: Further Form 4 filings from Control Empresarial de Capitales if oil prices keep climbing.

stories.headline: Arista's Bechtolsheim sells more stock on a 10b5-1 plan
stories.move: Andreas Bechtolsheim sold 267,892 shares of Arista Networks (ANET) on Oct. 30 across eight trades, at weighted-average prices from $167.51 to $174.14, an SEC Form 4 shows. The sales were made under a trading plan he adopted on Feb. 20, 2026, leaving him with 180,275,156 shares held indirectly through a trust.
stories.why: 10b5-1 plans let insiders schedule sales months in advance, so the timing doesn't necessarily reflect a view on the stock today.
stories.bear: Even routine, pre-scheduled selling by a company's largest insiders can weigh on sentiment if it continues for months.
stories.watch: Further sales under the same plan.

stories.headline: Shopify's revenue jumps 32%, but shares slip
stories.move: Shopify reported third-quarter revenue of $3.742 billion, up 32% year over year, with gross merchandise volume up 29% to $119.1 billion and operating income up 66% to $568 million, the company said in its Nov. 3 earnings release. Free cash flow margin improved to 22% from 18% a year earlier. For the fourth quarter, Shopify guided to revenue growth in the "low-thirties percentage rate" year over year, a touch below the third quarter's own pace.
stories.why: Investors often weigh Shopify's growth against its margin trajectory and next-quarter guidance rather than the headline revenue beat alone.
stories.bear: A small deceleration in guided growth can still outweigh a strong quarter if a stock was priced for continued acceleration.
stories.watch: Shopify's actual fourth-quarter results, expected in February, against the "low-thirties" guidance.

stories.read: Another beat for an under-the-radar holding
stories.headline: Ibotta tops guidance again as Koch holds a stake
stories.move: Ibotta reported third-quarter revenue of $97.8 million, up 17% year over year and above the top of its $94-$98 million guidance range, with adjusted EBITDA of $23.8 million, a 24.3% margin, the company said in its Nov. 2 earnings release. Koch, Inc., the holding company run by Charles Koch, has reported owning 4,389,129 Ibotta Class A shares worth about $149.9 million as of its most recent 13F filing.
stories.why: The beat shows one of Koch's public-market stock bets still performing well, even though a move this size in a small-cap barely registers for Koch's overall portfolio.
stories.bear: Ibotta's own fourth-quarter guidance of $94-$98 million revenue is only modestly above Q3's actual result, suggesting growth may be leveling off.
stories.watch: Koch, Inc.'s next 13F-HR, due around mid-November, for whether it kept or trimmed the Ibotta stake.

stories.read: Strong quarter for a Tencent-linked holding
stories.headline: Reddit's revenue jumps 53% as Tencent holds a stake
stories.move: Reddit reported third-quarter revenue of $895 million, up 53% year over year, with net income of $283 million and adjusted EBITDA of $402 million, a 45% margin, the company said in its Oct. 29 earnings release. Daily active uniques rose 12% to 130.3 million. Tencent subsidiaries have disclosed owning about 9.98% of Reddit's Class A shares, a stake for which Reddit CEO Steve Huffman holds the voting proxy, per a February 2025 SEC filing.
stories.why: The results show continued ad-revenue growth even as Reddit faces outside questions about AI-driven traffic to its site.
stories.bear: U.S. daily active uniques fell 2% year over year even as international usage grew, pointing to uneven growth beneath the headline number.
stories.watch: Whether U.S. usage stabilizes in the fourth quarter.

memo: A one-time wealth-tax ballot measure looks headed for defeat in California, but similar proposals could resurface elsewhere — worth tracking if your own ownership or your investors' is concentrated in one state.
Berkshire's DaVita sales are mechanical, tied to a contractual ownership cap — a reminder to check whether your own cap-table or buyback terms could force an unplanned transaction.
Shopify's 32% revenue growth wasn't enough to lift the stock on its own; guidance for the next quarter mattered more to investors than the quarter just finished.

movers.why: Shopify fell 8.7% after Q3 revenue grew 32% but Q4 growth guidance came in a touch softer.
Ibotta rose 20.5% after Q3 revenue beat the top of its guidance range by about $8 million.
